nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; if unsure use AMBIGUOUS; never skip corpus-size warnings; always show token cost and raw cohesion scores.

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: OpenCypher artifact or push to falkordb://localhost:6379; prefer --falkordb-push because GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time.

nodes.label: Neo4j Export
nodes.rationale: Generate cypher.txt or push via MERGE to bolt://localhost:7687; safe to re-run without duplicates.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Run graphify benchmark only when total_words > 5000; skip silently for small corpora.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Graphify Integration
nodes.rationale: graphify agents install writes a ## graphify section so agents check the graph before answering and rebuild after code changes.

nodes.label: Cluster-Only Mode
nodes.rationale: Self-contained re-cluster + report/html regen from existing graph; do not re-run Steps 5–9 which need deleted intermediates.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: Read-only integrity gate before labeling: surfaces dangling/missing endpoints, self-loops, and edge collapse without aborting.

nodes.label: Secret/
nodes.rationale: Local-only and gitignored — never commit

nodes.label: Folder Watch Mode (--watch)
nodes.rationale: Background watcher on .graphify_root; code changes rebuild via AST only; docs/papers/images set needs_update and require /graphify --update.

nodes.label: URL Corpus Ingest (/graphify add)
nodes.rationale: Fetch a URL into ./raw (YouTube, Twitter/X, arXiv, PDF, images, webpages), then run --update to merge into the graph.

nodes.label: Watch Debounce
nodes.rationale: Default 3s wait until file activity stops so parallel agent writes do not trigger a rebuild per file.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: graphify hook install appends a post-commit hook that AST-rebuilds on code file diffs; doc/image changes need manual --update.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Merges new extraction into graph.json preserving edge direction; re-extracted source_files replace stale nodes rather than duplicating.

nodes.label: Code-Only Update Fast Path
nodes.rationale: When all changed files are code, skip semantic extraction/subagents and run AST only.

nodes.label: Incremental Update (--update)
nodes.rationale: detect_incremental re-extracts only new/changed files; deletions prune via build_merge.

nodes.label: Structural AST Extraction (Part A)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, free code extraction via AST; no LLM and no API key.

nodes.label: MCP Graph Server
nodes.rationale: stdio MCP via graphify.serve exposing query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path.

nodes.label: Domain Hint Whisper Prompt
nodes.rationale: Compose GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_PROMPT from god-node labels (or a generic punctuation fallback for video-only corpora).

nodes.label: Whisper Video/Audio Transcription
nodes.rationale: Step 2.5: transcribe video/audio to text via Whisper, then treat transcripts as docs in semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction (Part B)
nodes.rationale: LLM extraction for docs, papers, and images only; skipped for code-only corpora; uses Gemini if keyed else the host agent.

nodes.label: No API Key Required
nodes.rationale: graphify needs no API key; code-only corpora skip semantic extraction entirely; Gemini is optional only for semantic docs/papers/images.

nodes.label: BFS Traversal
nodes.rationale: Default query mode for broad context / nearest neighbors (depth 3).

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: REQUIRED before traversal: expand the question to ≤12 tokens drawn only from graph label vocabulary; inventing tokens is forbidden.

nodes.label: save-result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Persist Q&A back into the graph with --outcome useful|dead_end|corrected so the next --update extracts expansion history.

nodes.label: Work Memory Reflect (LESSONS.md)
nodes.rationale: graphify reflect --if-stale refreshes preferred sources, known dead ends, and corrections for session-start guidance.

nodes.label: Fast Path Query
nodes.rationale: When graphify-out/graph.json exists and the user asks a natural-language codebase question (not a rebuild), skip Steps 1–5 and run graphify query immediately.

nodes.label: graphify clone
nodes.rationale: Clone GitHub URLs into ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuse existing clones on repeat runs.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs
nodes.rationale: Merge multiple graph.json files into one cross-repo or monorepo graph; merged nodes carry a repo attribute.

nodes.label: Per-Subfolder CLI Extract
nodes.rationale: For monorepos, run graphify extract inside each subfolder so graphify-out/ lands per path and avoids clobbering a shared cwd output.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Excludes bulky .cursor/skills/archify package so the graph reflects the MMM POC

nodes.label: STORY-101
nodes.rationale: Done: Path-C generator, integer counts, DATA_CARD.md

nodes.label: STORY-102
nodes.rationale: Done: shared transforms; generator imports them; Plotly figures (Jupyter DoD adapted away); perf gate

nodes.label: Agentic explain layer
nodes.rationale: LLMs orchestrate and narrate; they do not replace Bayesian math

nodes.label: baseline_sales
nodes.rationale: Site-wide daily KPI repeated on every channel row; do not sum across channels

nodes.label: Channel-day grain
nodes.rationale: 2912 rows = 728 days × 4 channels; campaign/ad-set/creative grain out of scope for STORY-101

nodes.label: transformations perf gate <1s
nodes.rationale: tests/test_transformations_perf.py asserts wall time <1s for geometric_adstock + weibull_adstock + hill_saturation on ~730 days × 4 channels

nodes.label: No leakage
nodes.rationale: Features, media, and outcomes must be point-in-time; never use future spend or conversions to fit today's effect

nodes.label: Dual remotes origin + github
nodes.rationale: Push intentional sprint work to both origin and github

nodes.rationale: baseline_sales = units/orders only; USD revenue deferred to later story/ETL mapping

nodes.label: ponytail: Comment Marker
nodes.rationale: Deliberate shortcuts name a ceiling and upgrade path so deferrals are tracked instead of rotting into permanent debt.

nodes.label: Ponytail Benchmark Medians
nodes.rationale: Published medians over 5 everyday tasks and 3 models; never invent per-repo savings because the unbuilt baseline does not exist.

nodes.label: Over-Engineering Review Tags
nodes.rationale: Tags delete/stdlib/native/yagni/shrink isolate complexity cuts from correctness, security, and performance review.

nodes.label: AI Slop Writing Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Research-backed patterns—thematic over-determination, performative filler, forced causal linearity, generic placeholders—distinguish low-quality AI prose from human writing.

nodes.label: Four-Phase Teaching Structure
nodes.rationale: Breaks complex concepts into micro-story hook, plain-English core, ASCII visual flow, and bridge-to-implementation so learners build intuition before coding.

nodes.label: Ponytail Laziness Ladder
nodes.rationale: Stop at first rung that holds: YAGNI, reuse in-repo, stdlib, native platform, installed deps, one-liner, then minimum code—after understanding the problem end-to-end.

nodes.label: DEEP_MODE
nodes.rationale: When --mode deep, be aggressive with INFERRED edges (indirect deps, shared assumptions); mark uncertain ones AMBIGUOUS.

nodes.label: Hyperedges
nodes.rationale: Optional group relations (participate_in|implement|form) when 3+ nodes share a flow not captured by pairwise edges; max 3 per chunk.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Spec
nodes.rationale: Subagent prompt for doc/paper/image chunks: JSON schema, node-ID rules, confidence rubric, hyperedges, vision rules.

nodes.label: semantically_similar_to Relation
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edge for concepts that solve the same problem without structural link; only when similarity is non-obvious and cross-cutting.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED edges always 1.0; INFERRED must use discrete scores 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55 never 0.5; AMBIGUOUS 0.1–0.3.

nodes.label: Deterministic Node ID Format
nodes.rationale: IDs are {full_repo_relative_stem}_{entity} with path segments joined by _; never append chunk numbers so the same entity always maps to the same ID.

nodes.label: EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED, INFERRED, or AMBIGUOUS so the graph stays an honest audit trail rather than a black-box similarity dump.
